findings.text: A REFUSED acknowledgement is treated as collectable. When XT_ACK_GTR_CLOSURE is set but apply_ack refuses (wrong md5/stopsSha/mismatched lists), problems becomes the refusal text, delta['stops'] may still be empty and delta['escalations'] non-empty, so the guard `not delta['stops'] and delta['escalations']` passes and the hook records a stop and exits 0 in a collect pass instead of the hard stop (exit 3). Scenario: escalation-only delta + stale ack file -> collect pass proceeds. Fix: also require 'acknowledgementRefused' not in delta (or check problems[0] does not start with 'closure acknowledgement refused'). Gtr_family (refusal adds non-FLIP/BAND stop) and urban_week_block (return 3 on refused ack) are correct.

Collect hook splices the changed block (withheld=[]) as if acknowledged; acceptable as the tree is rolled back, but downstream stages see provisional state; documented, no hard-stop bypass (ack flag absent only).

Collect pass never commits (journal.rollback always; commit branch is elif); token closed only after rb state rolled_back (exception path, normal path, --recover); failed rollback leaves token and rc 4; release_check.py:362 fails while any runs/*/collect.token exists. Verified; if a signal handler path kills the run the token remains (conservative).
